UNCERTIFIED — no hash-bound Viridis Comparator certificate covers this deposit's claims. Lean sources may compile but have not been independently certified. Results are conditional on the stated model assumptions.

Historical description:

Formal verification companion to Co-Measurement: Human-AI Dialogue as an Adaptive Measurement Instrument in the Data-Limited Regime of the Intelligence Bound (Hart 2026, Zenodo 20399676, submitted to Physical Review E).

Seven of seven theorems formally proven and kernel-clean. Five landed COMPLETE on the first Aristotle run (2026-05-24); FV-5 and FV-6 landed COMPLETE on a tightened resubmission (2026-05-27). Every accepted proof returns only the three standard Lean 4 kernel axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound); zero sorry, zero admit, no new axiom declarations.

  • FV-1 Optimal observation cadence (optimal_observation_cadence) — COMPLETE / Proven.
  • FV-2 Entropy reduction = mutual information (mutual_info_eq_entropy_sub_condEntropy, maximizer_iff) — COMPLETE / Proven.
  • FV-3 Entropy bounds on a finite alphabet (entropy_nonneg, entropy_le_log, entropy_eq_zero_iff, entropy_eq_log_iff) — COMPLETE / Proven.
  • FV-4 Conditioning reduces entropy (mutualInfo_nonneg, condEntropy_le_entropy, mutualInfo_eq_zero_iff, condEntropy_eq_entropy_iff) — COMPLETE / Proven.
  • FV-5 Decay of per-step information gain (chain_rule, jointMI_le_entropy, summable_perStepGain, perStepGain_tendsto_zero, perStepGain_nonneg) — COMPLETE / Proven on resubmission. The resubmission formalizes the discrete random-variable setup from scratch and derives entropy non-negativity, conditional-entropy non-negativity, strong subadditivity, and monotonicity from first principles, rather than taking them as hypotheses.
  • FV-6 Ordinary least-squares estimator (ols_unique_minimizer) — COMPLETE / Proven on resubmission. The principal theorem states both halves of the result (global minimality and uniqueness) under 2 ≤ n and the not-all-equal hypothesis on the x-values.
  • FV-7 Geometric convergence of a contraction (contraction_unique_fixedPoint, contraction_geometric_convergence) — COMPLETE / Proven.

Files. Seven Lean source files (fv1-optimal-cadence.lean through fv7-contraction-convergence.lean); a typeset verification report (co-measurement-verification.pdf) with its LaTeX source; the formal-verification targets specification (formal-verification-targets.md); the full results review (REVIEW.md) including resubmission notes; and a one-command verification harness (verify-fv6.sh). Toolchain: leanprover/lean4:v4.28.0, Mathlib pinned to the v4.28.0 tag.

Part of. The Viridis Compiled Theorem Stack — concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19317982. Latest canon snapshot: Zenodo 20100595 (Day 34, 17 modules, zero sorry).

Citation. Hart, J. D. (2026). Co-Measurement Formal Verification Companion: Seven Lean 4 Theorems Supporting the Co-Measurement Framework (v1.1.0). Zenodo. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20399473.
